APUG092 HDMI1.4b Transmitter V1.0 official reference subset
============================================================
Source: user-provided EG4S20 data/reference package
Original directory: APUG092_HDMI1.4b_Transmitter_V1.0/src/user_source/hdl_source/

Copied read-only vendor files:
- hdmi_1_4b_transmitter_core_wrapper.enc.v
- hdmi_phy_warpper.v
- lane_lvds_10_1.v

Official APUG092 facts used by this project:
- Video/EDID/Audio/ACR interfaces are in the pixel-clock domain.
- I_axis_s_user is a one-cycle frame-start pulse on the first active pixel.
- I_axis_s_valid marks active video data.
- I_axis_s_last is asserted at the end of each active line.
- O_axis_s_ready indicates the core can accept data.
- O_axis_s_ready only deasserts after I_axis_s_last; one active line must be
  supplied continuously without valid gaps.
- VIDEO_TPG must be "Disable" for external video input.
- RGB and YUV444 8-bit formats are supported.
- PHY serializer requires serial clock = 5 * pixel clock and uses DDR.
- hdmi_phy_wrapper supports DEVICE="EG" and selects EG_LOGIC_ODDR.
- APUG092 resource table lists EG4-family core use of about 1734 LUT,
  1925 REG and 17 ERAM (vendor reference figure, not this project's final
  implementation result).

Reference-package limitations relevant to HX4S20C:
- The supplied APUG092 example top/project is for PH1A, not EG4S20.
- The supplied pll.v instantiates PH1 primitives and must NOT be copied into
  the EG4S20 build.
- The supplied pin.adc is for that PH1A reference board and must NOT be reused
  for HX4S20C.
- APUG092 documentation tells users to obtain VIDEO_VIC from CTA-861.
- The supplied reference top configures the protected core for 1280x720 and
  passes VIDEO_VIC=69; the user guide uses 1920x1080/VIC16 as its default
  parameter/clock-calculation example.

Current integration status (P1-03B candidate):
- Project-owned apug092_core_wrapper and apug092_tx_wrapper now bind the
  protected core and official hdmi_phy_wrapper(DEVICE="EG").
- FPGA_Competition_HDMI_P1-03B.al is a dedicated TD5.6.2 harness with two
  injected top-level clocks. It does NOT claim the final board PLL or pins.
- constraints/p1_apug092_td.sdc now uses the project 1280x720 transport
  baseline: 74.25 MHz pixel and 371.25 MHz serial (=5x pixel) for this
  isolated clock-injected harness.
- Final 50 MHz HX4S20C -> EG PLL generation and HDMI/clock/DDC pin constraints
  remain P1-04 board-binding work and require official board evidence.

Do not edit the three vendor source files above.
